text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Trainer-san. Sorry for calling you 
over so suddenly. Please, this way.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Called by her, I stepped into the 
kitchen—and found an array of 
delicious-looking dishes laid out on the 
countertop.
choice_data_list: Umm... what are we doing now?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I would like to exchange opinions with you 
regarding diet today, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
For efficient conditioning, I thought we 
should review my diet not just for 
nutrition, but in terms of flavor as well.
choice_data_list:
This amount... I can feel an extraordinary 
passion coming from it.

This amount... I can feel an extraordinary 
passion coming from it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Yes, it's only natural to be particular 
about meals in order to build a strong 
body.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This body is my pride, given to me by my 
beloved parents. Therefore, I must be 
strong, swift, and beautiful.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Let's begin exchanging our thoughts right 
away.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: First up is this yakisoba.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I've abundantly incorporated green and 
yellow vegetables rich in 
beta-carotene—which converts to vitamin A 
in the body— and vitamin E.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Vitamin A's absorption rate increases when 
cooked with oil. I used sesame oil, which 
resists oxidation and is rich in oleic 
acid.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, sunflower oil contains more 
vitamin E than sesame oil――which do you 
think I should prioritize right now?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
After exchanging opinions for a while on 
physical conditioning and the necessary 
nutrients for it...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I have a general understanding of the 
nutrients that should be prioritized. All 
that's left is the taste.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Before Dream Journey began eating her 
meal, there was one thing I wanted to 
check with her.
choice_data_list:
Um... you're not eating all of this, 
right?

Um... you're not going to eat all of this, 
right?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
...? Naturally, I will eat all of it. It 
is necessary for this body of mine.
choice_data_list:
Eating all of that is definitely too 
much...

Got it. Let's devour everything with 
passion!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
However, unless I eat it all, I won't be 
able to judge its quality. I also want to 
gauge how satisfying and filling it is.
choice_data_list: In that case, I'll eat it instead!
In that case, I'll eat it instead!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
That would be a great help. In that case, 
I will limit myself to just a single taste 
of each. I'll leave the rest to you, 
Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Bon appétit, please enjoy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey only took a taste, eating 
just the right amount of food.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Yes. ...Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This stir-fried vegetable dish... makes me 
eat more rice than expected. Perhaps I 
should reconsider the sodium level next 
time.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
This hamburg steak is based on my mother's 
recipe... It makes you want to go for 
seconds right away...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Dream Journey ended up polishing off the 
massive mountain of food completely...
